triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing subscription rights to its common shareholders to purchase the Fund’s common shares.

subject_names.span: “Fund,” refers to Clough Global Opportunities Fund.

subject_tickers.span: shares are traded on the NYSE American LLC under the symbol “GLO”.

security_class.span: The Fund is issuing subscription rights to its common shareholders to purchase the Fund’s common shares.

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every three Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

price_pct.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

price_floor_pct_nav.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

record_date.span: The Fund is issuing transferable subscription Rights to its Common Shareholders of record as of May 25, 2021 (the “Record Date” and such shareholders, “Record Date Shareholders”).

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 22, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus (the “Expiration Date”).

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE American under the symbol “GLO RT” during the course of the Offer.

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an Over-Subscription Privilege.

max_new_shares.span: These Rights will allow Record Date Shareholders to subscribe for new common shares of the Fund in an aggregate amount of approximately 13,426,838 common shares (the “Offer”).

notes: Subscription price is the higher of 85% of NAV or 95% of market price (market = average of last reported sales prices on NYSE American for the five trading days preceding the Expiration Date, excluding the Expiration Date), determined on the Expiration Date. The schema has one price_pct; recorded price_reference=greater_of_nav_and_market, price_pct=95 (the percent applied to market) and price_floor_pct_nav=85 (the 85%-of-NAV leg acts as a floor). Another reading would put 85 in price_pct. Estimated Subscription Price $11.83 as of May 14, 2021. Expiration June 22, 2021 unless extended; no extension stated. Max shares 'approximately 13,426,838' (cover: 'Rights for 13,426,838 Shares'); the Fund will not sell shares unsubscribed after the over-subscription; no secondary over-allotment stated (a dilution table footnote mentions a 'Secondary Over-Subscription Privilege' without a size). Rights trade on NYSE American as 'GLO RT'. Board may eliminate the Over-Subscription Privilege.
